caption: The drawing depicts six rectangular swatches, each filled with a different geometric pattern, arranged in two columns and three rows on a light beige background. The top left rectangle is filled with a tan lattice pattern featuring diagonal diamond shapes with brown outlines. The top right rectangle consists of a reddish-brown grid composed of intersecting horizontal and vertical lines, forming a checkerboard of squares. The middle left rectangle displays a blue and off-white woven pattern that resembles interlocking strips, some stippled with dots. The middle right rectangle is filled with a pattern of white rectangles scattered on a solid black background in a staggered arrangement. The bottom left rectangle features an arrangement of thin and thick brown and black lines, forming a plaid pattern with some translucid white areas between the lines. The bottom right rectangle contains a brown and white checkerboard pattern, with the brown squares shaded to create a textured appearance. Each swatch has straight edges and is separated by white space from the others.
title: Vest Material
